rows.event: Walk-in Interview for Senior Administrative Assistant and Multi-Skilled Assistant (Accounts)

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IISER Pune Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for IISER Pune?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview dates vary by post. For Senior Administrative Assistant and Multi-Skilled Assistant (Accounts), it is on 01 September 2026. For Administrative Assistant, it is on 03 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Senior Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Administration, Commerce, or Management with a minimum of 50% marks or an equivalent grade.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all advertised posts is 45 years. Age relaxation may be considered for candidates with higher qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 50,000/- per month, depending on the specific post and experience.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the IISER Pune recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these roles?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the IISER Pune office, Pune, Maharashtra, 411008.

faq.question: Q9. Are these posts permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
